# SlideAudioInserter

**SlideAudioInserter** is a Python script which embeds MP3 audio files voicing the names of deceased trans people into a TDoR memorial PowerPoint presentation generated by the site at [https://tdor.translivesmatter.info/reports](https://tdor.translivesmatter.info/reports).

The source of the names does not matter - they can either be TTS (as generated by ``SpeakNames`), or manually recorded.

This allows name readings to be synchronised with the PowerPoint slides during  a TDoR vigil.


## Prerequisites

To run this script you will need:

- A Windows 10/11 installation (though only the latter has been tested with suitable TTS voices)
- A [Python 3.x](https://www.python.org/downloads/) interpreter and the Python libraries the script uses (see below)
-

No additional Python libraries are used by the script.


## Command Line Arguments

- `--input` or `-i`: Specifies the pathname of a PowerPoint document containing a single slide per victim (as downloaded from [https://tdor.translivesmatter.info/reports](https://tdor.translivesmatter.info/reports)).
- `--output` or `-o`: The path to save the modified document to (optional).
- `---audio-folder` or `-a`: The path of a folder containing MP3 audio clips to insert. If not specified, no changes will be made'.
- `--leave-open` or `-l`: Leave PowerPoint open after editing (optional).
- `--help` or `-h` : Display help on available commands.


## Usage


To update `input.pptx` with the voices in the `audio` subfolder, leaving PowerPoint open without saving the result (use for preview/checking):

```
python SpeakNames.py --input ./input.pptx --audio-folder ./audio --leave-open
```

To silently update `input.pptx` with the voices in the `audio` subfolder, saving the result to `output.pptx`:

```
python SpeakNames.py --input ./input.pptx --audio-folder ./audio --output ./output.pptx
```
